notFound: Frigidaire: frigidaire.com refused both a plain fetch (empty reply) and WebFetch (HTTP 503), so its models are read from The Home Depot's own Frigidaire listings (the first 12 of 13 washer and dryer results, of which only 5 are single machines, plus all 16 dishwashers), and anything Frigidaire sells only at Lowe's or Best Buy is missing.

Electrolux: electroluxappliances.com refused the fetch, so models come from Abt's and The Home Depot's own Electrolux listings (Abt's 'Comp. Value' and Home Depot's was-price recorded as the regular price), the laundry towers and Home Depot's washer-dryer sets were skipped as pairs sold as one listing, and no Electrolux dishwashers beyond Abt's three were found.

Miele: mieleusa.com answered 403, so Miele models are read from Abt's listings, where only some washers and dryers show a regular price ('Comp. Value') and the other washers, dryers and all dishwashers show a single price, which is recorded, and Miele's commercial Little Giants PWM 908 and PDR 908 units were skipped.

Bosch: bosch-home.com shows 107 dishwasher-category results at 12 per page and ignores a page parameter, so the 41 dishwashers read come from its default, price-sorted, rating-sorted, front-control, custom-panel, 18-inch and top-control views, three top-control models never appeared in any view, and SHE3ADF5N shows no price, so those are left out.

Capacity is not stated for Bosch's compact dryers, Miele's dryers and Asko's washers and dryers, and Bosch's three compact washer capacities were read from Abt's tiles because Bosch's own tiles omit them, so capacityCuFt is null where nothing states it.

Place settings are not stated on the LG, Bosch, Frigidaire, Electrolux, Miele, Fisher & Paykel or Asko listings (and Samsung's spec feed has no entry for DW80CG5420SRAA), so placeSettings is null for those dishwashers.
dryerType is null for 146 of 182 dryers because their pages do not say vented, condenser or heat pump.

LG: lg.com shows an MSRP and a lower current price and the MSRP is recorded as the regular price, except for WT7480CL and DLGX7481LE, whose listing shows a current price above the MSRP, so the higher figure is recorded.

LG: records that lg.com flags as hidden (WT7300CW, LDP7808SS, LUDP8997SN) or lists with no price (WT6485CW, WT8480CL, DLE6480W, DLG6481W, DLG7151X, DLE8480LE, DLG8481LE, LDFN343LS) were left out, as were discontinued models.
LG: SideKick pedestal washers (UWD1CW, WD100CW, WD200CB, WD200CV, WD205CK, WD300CA, WD405CP), WashTower single units, and the laundry and kitchen packages were skipped as pedestals, pairs or bundles.

Samsung: the product finder returns at most 10 families per query, so every washer, dryer and dishwasher family was reached by combining sort orders, and the Bespoke AI Laundry Hub WH46DBH* stacked units (pairs in one listing) and DV25B6900EW/A2 (not for sale on samsung.com) were left out.

Speed Queen: speedqueen.com lists its 30 residential models without prices, so prices come from Speed Queen's own shop feed at buy.speedqueen.com, and the SF7008 stacked washer-dryers and PDR108 pedestals were skipped.

Fisher & Paykel: its US all-washing-machines page redirected to the home page and no laundry category could be found, so no washers or dryers are included, and its dishwasher tiles say 'starting from', so each model's base price is recorded.

Asko: the old askousa.com no longer serves Asko, so the 41 Asko models are read from US Appliance's own storefront catalogue (available, priced items only, with its regular base price recorded) and discontinued items, DC7784 drying cabinets and HP320 pedestals were skipped.

Midea: midea.com/us returns an empty laundry listing and marks its washer page Discontinued, Home Depot lists no Midea washers, dryers or dishwashers and US Appliance only a refrigerator, and midea.com's dishwasher pages reset the connection, so no Midea model was confirmed.
Beko: beko.com/us-en refused with 403 and US Appliance lists all 90 of its Beko items as discontinued with no price, so no Beko model was confirmed.

Blomberg: blombergappliances.com lists its compact washers, dryers and dishwashers with a price of $0.00, and Abt, US Appliance and Home Depot show no Blomberg stock (Appliances Connection refused the fetch), so none are included.
AJ Madison (bot check), Appliances Connection (TLS refusal) and Lowe's (403) refused automated fetches and Best Buy was not tried, so models sold mainly there are not covered.
Model year: no listing states a model year, so year is null for every product, and eprel is null throughout because these are US pages.
